0.reason: follow-up on the plan: extend station.SweepBeat with settle() and last() and run the landing worker on it

findings.text: _LandingWorker re-implements the capability SweepBeat already owns at reckon/crew/station.py:144 — a thread started off the tick path, in-flight exclusion, and an exception contained so the loop survives — and does not extend or wrap it; only settle() and last() are new, and those could be added to the owner so one mechanism serves both.

the land command now passes --no-impl-change with LANDING_BEAT_REASON on every landing, waiving the promotion check that a passing implement run moved its plan section; the section text does not ask for it, and nothing records whether the landing beat meant to advance impl afterwards ran, so a landed run whose section never advanced reads the same as one that did.

worker.stop() joins for LANDING_STOP_SECONDS (1.0 s) and the daemon thread then dies with the process, so a land step still in flight when the service stops exceeds that second and its srun child is left orphaned mid-merge rather than drained or refused.

an assertion was updated in a file outside the node's declared write paths; the change is one line and forced by the --no-impl-change flag the section requires, and the worker declared it under outside_scope.
